supersession_note: Refines, but does not delete, earlier D005 'Stern/EffectGate-style' wording. The donor has a useful request/outcome journal shape, but exact source does not establish normal PreToolUse rejection as the actual execution gate.

findings.finding: zulassen() computes and journals admission-like checks, but the normal PreToolUse live branch intentionally emits no deny/block response after zulassen().
merken() can create VERIFIED after successful PostToolUse even when no PreToolUse row exists; VERIFIED therefore cannot be treated as proof of admitted execution.
gw_absicht later uses effects.status=VERIFIED as aussenwirkung, so the donor currently overloads one status across observed-success and admitted-then-verified semantics.

triggerword4_required_design_delta: Use an explicit AdmissionDecision {ALLOW,DENY,UNKNOWN} bound to effect_id/causal_id/generation and produced before real execution by deterministic control-plane authority.
Use a distinct ObservedOutcome {SUCCEEDED,FAILED,UNKNOWN} with evidence/provenance after execution; outcome observation never retroactively mints admission.
Use a distinct ReentryStatus/receipt for observed post-effect state; causal_episodes credit or reentered flags cannot be inferred from request or tool return alone.
If admission is missing/UNKNOWN, preserve the observed outcome but grant zero admitted-effect credit.
If external effect outcome is transport-ambiguous, retain UNKNOWN and never blindly replay.
Bind each effect to a per-call identity rather than relying only on one session-level active_turns.effect_id pointer unless serialization is formally proven.
Keep lifecycle hooks as adapters/audit surfaces if useful, but place the actual EffectGate at the executor/host boundary that can deterministically prevent execution.
Audit all downstream consumers of effects.status before schema migration so VERIFIED semantic overload cannot survive into EntityOS/HCU.
counterhypothesis: A host permission layer outside stern.py may be the real execution authority. If proven, adapt that host gate into the successor rather than forcing stern.py to become a blocker; the invariant is one deterministic effect authority, not preservation of a specific file/function.
falsifier: Show exact current host/executor code and runtime receipt proving every state-changing tool is denied before execution whenever zulassen records ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG/unknown admission, including timeout/error cases, with exact effect identity carried through PostToolUse and re-entry.
next_exact_gate: Trace current realtime_gespraech Function-Calling/tool execution path and host permission boundary, then recover Git chronology for zulassen/merken fallback semantics.
